root_cause.text: In xfrm_policy_bysel_ctx(), the inexact bin pruning was performed after releasing xfrm_policy_lock, allowing a concurrent xfrm_hash_rebuild to free the bin via kfree_rcu before the pruning access, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The race scenario in the commit message shows CPU0 releases the lock after unlink, then CPU1 frees the bin while CPU0 later calls xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin. The patch moves `__xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin(bin, false)` inside the locked section (before `spin_unlock_bh`) to prevent the race.
